{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep the row with the highest sample_seq per patient_id
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Filter for treatment arm
treatment_only = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Compute fraction of responders
fraction_responded = treatment_only['responded'].mean()

# Print the result
print(fraction_responded)"}
